<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Cursor's IDE agent edits files with Write and StrReplace, but cursor-adapter.ts only extracts file evidence from ApplyPatch string payloads. Those edits emit zero file events, so attribution silently reports 0% agent on code an agent wrote entirely — a well-formed report with a confident wrong number, not an error. This adds both tool vocabularies behind a closed registry, and a read-side honesty counter that fires when write-shaped calls yielded no file events, so the next Cursor rename is loud instead of silent.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Cursor Write/StrReplace edits produce file events with correct per-file line and byte deltas
- A Cursor session's agent-contribution share computes correctly end to end, not as 0%
- Both tool vocabularies coexist — ApplyPatch never deprecated, since this is a Cursor version rename not a surface split
- A future Cursor tool rename surfaces as a named gap rather than a silent zero

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Fixing the Claude adapter's Map.set churn loss — logged, not worked
- Diagnosing the win=0..0 capture stall — plan-070 class, judged only after this lands
- V4A 'Move to:' rename handling — dropped to follow-up, no local specimen exercises it
- Changing the segment wire version — additionalProperties:false pins 2.7, so the counter is read-side by construction
